name: Project Manager Dialog
description: Edits an optional Project group name or creates a group while moving the exact Workspace in one commit.

states: Open Manage Project and save or cancel an optional group name without changing Workspace membership or terminal state.
Choose New Project from a Workspace Move menu and commit the new group and exact Workspace membership together.

useWhen: A person needs to rename an optional Project group.
A person creates a new group while moving an existing Workspace.
avoidWhen: The person is creating an independent Workspace; use the one-click New Workspace action.
The person edits launch resources or Workspace defaults; use the Workspace manager.
invariants: The name draft is committed only by the outer Save or Create action and cancellation changes nothing.
Creating a Project from a Workspace menu commits group creation and membership together.
Group identity never owns launch resources, terminal identity, or physical Git identity.
